prompt.description: What to create, or for edits, what to change. Be specific about subject, style, composition and any text that should appear in the image.

images.description: Images to edit, or to use as references for style and subject when creating a new image, in order. Local file paths (relative to the session directory or absolute) or http(s) URLs.

model.description: NEVER set this unless the user explicitly asks for a particular image model or variant. The value is written as "providerID/modelID", or "providerID/modelID#variant" to include a variant. Do not guess the ID: look it up with the models tool using type: "image", filtering to your own provider first.

path.description: Where to save the image, relative to the session directory or absolute. The extension is replaced with the image's real format, and an existing file is overwritten. Defaults to a new file in the session's temp folder.

id.description: The image job's ID, repeated in its completion notice

path.description: Where the image is saved, without its extension
